project.name: LAST DOOR
project.summary: When evidence changes, LAST DOOR rebuilds the WebMCP tool surface and proves why the agent continued, recovered, or stopped.
project.ai_usage: ChatGPT's in-app browser acts as the WebMCP agent under test; deterministic page-owned rules control authority and evidence.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported implementation, evaluation, QA, release verification, submission drafting, and source-backed Archify diagrams.
